q: How much energy does the Balasore plastic cluster use, and what share is grid power?
title: Balasore plastics: grid power share and CO2
short: 84% of the energy, and more of the carbon. TERI's 2015 profile puts Balasore's 40 or so plastic units at 2,860 toe a year: 27.8 million kWh of grid power, 452 kL of diesel and 36 t of LPG. On today's factors that is about 20,000 t CO2, 93% of it from electricity.
audience: Pipe, sack, film and moulding units in the Balasore plastic cluster, Odisha

ul: Pipes and fittings: 6 units, 39,000 t a year, 1,755 toe. More than 60% of the cluster's energy.
Poly bags and sacks: 13 units, 10,500 t, 450 toe.
Others: 16 units, 8,300 t, 435 toe. Total 62,600 t.

p: Most units have an LT connection of about 100 kVA; pipe and sack plants have HT connections of 400 kVA or more. Diesel runs DG sets in outages, which have become uncommon. A few non-woven sack plants fire thermic fluid heaters with oil.

sections.h: Where the kWh go, and what cuts them
ul: Barrel heaters: radiant heater bands with thyristor control save 20 to 30%.
Hydraulic injection moulding: all-electric machines use 50 to 80% less; servo drives on hydraulics save about 30%.
Extruder motors: variable speed drives save up to 20%.
Compressed air: every bar of pressure you drop saves about 6%.

example.title: Cluster CO2 on today's factors (estimate)
lines: Electricity: 27.8 million kWh x 0.675 kg = 18,765 t CO2
Diesel: 452 kL x 2.645 t = 1,196 t CO2
Total about 20,070 t, or 0.32 t CO2 per tonne of product
Pipes, if their 1,755 toe were all power: about 523 kWh and 353 kg CO2 per tonne
example.note: Quantities from TERI's Balasore profile. Grid factor CEA FY 2025-26; fuels IPCC 2006.

senseible: Senseible reads your electricity bills (units, tariff, sanctioned load) and DG diesel invoices into monthly records, so your carbon number per tonne comes from your own meter, not a cluster average.
